title: Word Blitz
blurb: Race friends to unscramble words in real-time. Multiplayer, no account needed.

title: Snake Sprint
blurb: Eat pellets, grow longer, avoid yourself. Classic arcade skill game.

title: Memory Match
blurb: Flip cards and find all the pairs. Beat your time and best score.

title: Snake Duel
blurb: Two snakes duel head to head. Grow to 6 to win, or shoot your rival to pieces.
